newsitem.title: FRANCE: French stocks seen starting on firm note.
newsitem.headline: French stocks seen starting on firm note.

text.p: French shares were seen starting on a firm note helped by a robust tone to bonds, ahead of key U.S. retail sales and producer prices data due at 1230 GMT.
The CAC-40 futures index was up 6.5 points at 2,612.5 at 0735 GMT. The blue-chip CAC-40 index closed down on Thursday 9.58 points or 0.37 percent at 2,607.97.
Trading in shares of Cie de Suez, Lyonnaise des Eaux has been suspended ahead of merger announcement expected later on Friday.
